name: client-credentials-grant-demo
description: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Grant demo with Keycloak, Express and React

scripts.start: npm run keycloak:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently --names local-api,local-frontend,third-party-api,third-party-frontend --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm start -w local-api" "npm run dev -w local-frontend" "npm start -w third-party-api" "npm run dev -w third-party-frontend"
